shortDescription: True fans show their subscription receipts and skip the line — Wildcard fast-track signup for Kimi Talk events
longDescription: Browse upcoming Kimi Talk and official community offline events and sign up in a conversation. Power users can authorize a read-only capture of their own Kimi subscription page (plan, usage, member since, subscription count) for Wildcard fast-track verification. Wildcard is a generic event-signup tiering brand; this plugin is the Kimi edition.
tryPrompts: Show me upcoming Kimi Talk events
I want to sign up for the Shanghai Kimi Talk
I have a Wildcard — use fast-track verification for my signup

wildcard-for-kimi.description: Browse and sign up for Kimi Talk events; power users get Wildcard fast-track verification via their own subscription info
